title: Quick Descending Ladders
description: A simple datapack that allows you to descend ladders quicker.
body:
![quick descending ladders title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/677d9f336a2ed2364cd7fc65f9e0e7aef52fe77a.png)

# What does it do?
**Quick Descending Ladders** allows you do quickly climb down ladders by simply looking straight down. Looking straight down will quickly descend you down any ladder or climbable block!\
This datapack is compatible with other datpacks which make other blocks climbable, such as chains.
